mathematical_definition: Raw pass-through of the input DataFrame's tick_volume column (df['tick_volume'].to_numpy(dtype=float64)); NaN if the column is absent
numerical_stability_notes: Coverage degrades after 2020-09-28 (tick_volume_degrades_after=2020-09-28, measured 2026-08-19 via research/historical_coverage.py against data/gold_seed_merged_full6yr.csv: trailing-30-day nonzero fraction drops below 5% starting that date). Full-pipeline ablation without tick_volume: primary accuracy delta -0.03pp (noise-level); permutation importance small but positive and unstable (fold CV=0.92) -- no evidence it is actively harmful, weak evidence it helps, real evidence of a source-scale reliability concern documented in the prior masterplan
missing_value_policy: NaN if the 'tick_volume' column is absent from the input df, else the raw broker-reported value is passed through unmodified
